title: Crystal Guardians TD
description:
Crystal guardians is a rogue-like tower defense game where you need to defend your base crystal on an expanding procedural generated battlefield. Gain a strategic advantage using the many towers + crystal combinations and unique item combinations stored in those towers. Make use of the expanding battlefield by placing towers on strategic position for maximal damage to the enemies.Key features• Loads of unique tower loadout combinations to be made

• Currently over 100 items available

• 36 tower combinations

• Extensive meta progression

• 10 unique boss rounds

• Loads of different enemies

• Unique rounds

• Procedural generated levels, every run is different 
Defend your base in this challenging tower defenseBuild the perfect loadouts on towers36 tower combosMeta progressionVarious boss rounds to defeat
description_short: Crystal Guardians is a tower defense game with rogue-like elements. Fight of waves and defend the world crystal. Gear up your towers with a powerful combination of items for your strategy. In an ever expanding map, find hidden powers and conquer the enemies.
